candidates.description: risk-off switch (Sahm-like gap >= 0.5 p.p. only): 50/50 shrinkage of BVAR_MINNESOTA toward the frozen comparator distribution; inverse-MSE ensemble otherwise
candidates.motivation: v1 (ENSEMBLE_REGIME) fixed the C4 RMSE in recessions (0.9734/0.9035) but failed C4 CRPS (1.0019/1.0133) and C1 W2 (0.9705); v2 removes the noisy inversion trigger and shrinks the risk-off distribution to the benchmark
candidates.design_disclosure: shrinkage to the comparator is a standard robustification; the risk-off distribution is not exactly the comparator (BVAR point gets 50% weight), so C4 is not a by-construction equality; v1 remains published and is not re-scored
candidates.note: registered before its own evaluation; report protocols/regime_v2_candidate_evaluation_report.json
